data_output.description: data.load(data_dir, max_rows_per_split=None) returns train, valid, and test row lists in existing canonical source-derived chronological split order. data.encode(splits) returns (encoded, dimension), where encoded[name] is (features, labels, users). For every split, features is a two-dimensional np.int32 matrix with exactly six columns ordered [user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday, hashed_video_id_tab]. Columns 0 through 4 use the parent train-fitted vocabulary plus one unknown ID per field and retain their parent offsets and values. Column 5 is the deterministic FNV-1a-64 bucket of str(video_id)+'\x1f'+str(tab), modulo 262144, offset after the first five field ranges. labels is float32 for train/valid and None for test; users is the raw user_id vector in the same row order. dimension is an int strictly greater than every feature ID and equals the sum of all six field dimensions.

model_input.description: Model receives dimension from data.encode and a features np.int32 matrix with six valid global categorical IDs per row. The unchanged additive Model indexes weights by all six columns and sums them with the bias. train.py supplies labels only for train batches and valid proxy evaluation; it selects checkpoints and early-stops only using valid_features, valid_labels, and valid_users. Test features have no labels and are used only after loading the validation-selected checkpoint for prediction artifact generation.

feature_engineer.objective: Implement candidate c02 exclusively in data.py: append exactly one deterministic hashed categorical interaction feature for the eligible request-time raw pair (video_id, tab) to experiment 1's existing additive categorical feature matrix.
required_changes: In data.py, retain the existing five base fields in their existing order: user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday. Append one additional feature column after weekday representing only the pair of raw row values row[2] (video_id) and row[3] (tab).

Define the interaction from the exact raw fields video_id and tab only. Use a deterministic, process-independent FNV-1a 64-bit hash over the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical string str(video_id) + '\x1f' + str(tab), then map it with modulo 262144. Do not use Python's built-in hash().

Reserve exactly 262144 categorical IDs for this interaction field. Its encoded value must be interaction_bucket + interaction_offset, where interaction_offset follows all six field dimensions' cumulative offsets.

Update the feature-field definition, raw-value derivation, vocabulary/dimension construction, and encoding so encode(splits) returns an int32 feature matrix of shape (rows_in_split, 6). The first five columns must preserve their parent encoded meanings exactly; the sixth column must be the new hashed interaction.

Keep train-only vocabulary fitting for the five existing categorical fields. The new hashed interaction requires no vocabulary fitting and must use the same fixed bucket recipe for train, valid, and test.
Return the total model dimension as the sum of the five train-vocabulary-plus-unknown dimensions and the fixed 262144 interaction dimension. Do not change model.py, train.py, or config.json.
preserve: Continue loading only the existing standard log files and retain the existing chronological split boundaries and labels.
Continue deriving hour solely as floor(numeric hourmin / 100) constrained to 0..23, and weekday solely from raw date as Monday=0 through Sunday=6.
Do not add any raw source, join, label-derived feature, forbidden field, quarantined field, or aggregate. In particular, use only raw video_id and raw tab for the interaction.
Preserve split row order exactly, so validation and test encoded rows remain in canonical source-derived split order.
Preserve encode's return interface: encoded is keyed by train, valid, and test, with each value (features, labels, users); labels remain None only for test and users remain sourced from raw user_id.

Preserve compatibility with the unchanged Model and train.py, including validation-only early stopping/checkpoint selection and emission of predictions_valid.npz and predictions_test.npz by the fixed training command.
coordination_notes: The unchanged trainer passes the returned dimension directly to Model and consumes arbitrary-width int32 feature rows; no trainer or model change is required.

The appended interaction is additive because Model.logits sums the learned weights indexed by every feature column. Exactly one new feature column must be added; do not introduce separate video-tab components, numerical interaction values, or model architecture changes.

The fixed training command must continue to produce predictions_valid.npz and predictions_test.npz, each containing exactly row_ids and scores. The unchanged trainer's sequential row_ids correspond to the preserved canonical validation and test feature-row order respectively.

reasoning: Activate only feature_engineer because the requested exact ablation changes only the encoded additive feature matrix. The raw fields video_id and tab are eligible request-time inputs. A fixed deterministic hash permits a single categorical interaction feature without fitting a validation/test-informed vocabulary, while preserving all parent objective, optimizer, stopping, model, and configuration behavior.
